title: Root cause: _name_with_digits_p regex in sympy/printing/conventions.py only matched ASCII letters, so Greek-letter names like ω0 kept a literal trailing digit in unicode pretty printing
Fix applied: regex changed to r'^([^\W\d_]+)(\d+)$', re.UNICODE — Symbol('ω0') now pretty-prints as ω₀; matrix shows [t₀⋅ω₀  t₁⋅ω₀  t₂⋅ω₀]
evidence_refs: pretty ω0 -> 'ω₀'; 297 passed, 3 xfailed in test_pretty.py + test_conventions.py + test_latex.py
